name: Exception Path EX-002 — Sanctions Hit, Account Freeze and MLRO Escalation
description: Exception path EX-002: Sanctions screening (SVC-051) returns a confirmed match against the OFSI Consolidated List during PH-003. Account opening is immediately blocked. SanctionsHitDetected event is published to the event bus. MLRO (PER-052) is alerted immediately. Any funds received are frozen. The customer receives a standard decline notification without disclosure of the sanctions reason (tipping-off prohibition, POCA 2002 s333A). OFSI notification must occur within 14 days of confirmed designated person identification. WORM audit log entries are created at each key action for regulatory evidence.

steps.action: Application submitted and identity verification completed (PASS)
steps.description: Steps PH-001 and PH-002 proceed as per the happy path. ApplicationStarted and IdentityVerificationCompleted (outcome: pass) events have been published.
SVC-014 receives IdentityVerificationCompleted and calls SVC-051. Applicant has dual nationality (GB, RU). All four lists screened.

data.SanctionsScreenRequest: { entity_type: individual, individual: { first_name: Nikolai, last_name: Petrov, date_of_birth: 1975-03-22, nationality: [GB, RU] }, lists_to_check: [OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU], context: { application_id, customer_id } }

steps.description: SVC-051 returns status = blocked. 94% match confidence against OFSI Consolidated List (OFSI-GBP-0001234) and EU Sanctions List. Designated person under UK Russia Sanctions Regulations 2019.

data.SanctionsScreenResponse: { status: blocked, overall_result: blocked, match_detail: { list_name: OFSI, designated_person_ref: OFSI-GBP-0001234, match_confidence_percentage: 94, matched_name: Nikolai Petrov, designation_date: 2022-03-10 }, lists_checked: [OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU], processing_time_ms: 498 }

steps.note: Stateless result — SVC-051 does not persist. SVC-014 must persist in KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result and act immediately.

steps.action: Set sanctions_screening_result.status = blocked; set KycAssessment.status = blocked
steps.description: SVC-014 persists the sanctions hit in KycAssessment (ENT-003): sanctions_screening_result.status = blocked, match_detail persisted. KycAssessment.status = blocked. No KYCClearanceGranted event will be published.

data.KycAssessment_update: { status: blocked, sanctions_screening_result: { status: blocked, match_detail: { ... } }, assessor: automated }

steps.description: SVC-014 writes immutable WORM audit log entry: sanctions hit detected, matched list, match confidence, timestamp, customer_id, assessment_id. This is OFSI compliance evidence. Audit log entry is write-once, append-only.

data.audit_entry: { event_type: SanctionsHitDetected, customer_id, assessment_id, list_name: OFSI, match_confidence: 94, detected_at, assessor: automated }
data.classification: HIGHEST — restricted to MLRO + FCA/NCA production only

steps.note: WORM (Write-Once Read-Many) storage. Immutable. Required for OFSI notification evidence and FCA supervisory record. Retention: 5 years minimum (MLR 2017 Reg 40).

steps.description: SVC-014 publishes SanctionsHitDetected domain event to the event bus immediately. Payload must not include match_detail that could tip off the customer. Consumers: SVC-001 (block provisioning), SVC-017 (display standard decline), SVC-053 (trigger sanitised decline notification), SVC-111 (audit).

data.payload: { assessment_id, customer_id, list_name: OFSI, match_confidence: 94, detected_at }
data.note: Payload does not include designated_person_ref or match_detail — tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A)

steps.action: Block account provisioning — ApplicationRecord status = declined
steps.description: SVC-001 receives SanctionsHitDetected and sets ApplicationRecord.status = declined with decline_reason = sanctions_hit. Account provisioning is permanently blocked for this application. No Account record (ENT-004) is created.

data.ApplicationRecord_update: { status: declined, decline_reason: sanctions_hit, current_phase: EX-002 }

steps.description: SVC-001 writes WORM audit entry: ApplicationRecord blocked due to sanctions hit. Records that no account was opened, no funds accepted.

data.audit_entry: { event_type: ApplicationBlockedSanctions, application_id, customer_id, blocked_at, reason: sanctions_hit }

steps.description: Customer receives standard decline notification: 'We are unable to open an account for you at this time.' No indication of sanctions match. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) strictly applied. FOS signpost included per Consumer Duty PS22/9.

data.notification_email: Subject: Your account application — important information. Body: We are unable to open an account for you at this time. If you believe this decision is incorrect, you may contact the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS). [FOS link and contact details].
data.notification_in_app: We are unable to proceed with your application at this time.

steps.note: CRITICAL: No mention of sanctions, designated person status, or OFSI. Tipping-off prohibition is absolute (POCA 2002 s333A).

steps.action: MLRO immediate alert — sanctions hit confirmed
steps.description: SVC-014 (or compliance case management system) immediately alerts the MLRO (PER-052) with full sanctions match detail: designated person reference, list name, match confidence, customer identity data. MLRO must begin OFSI notification process.

data.mlro_alert: { alert_type: SANCTIONS_HIT_CONFIRMED, customer_id, assessment_id, designated_person_ref: OFSI-GBP-0001234, list_name: OFSI, match_confidence: 94, detected_at, ofsi_notification_deadline: detected_at + 14 days }

steps.note: MLRO alert contains full sensitive details. Restricted to PER-052 only. Not shared with PER-001, PER-056, or channel services.

steps.action: WORM audit log — MLRO review initiated
steps.description: MLRO records: sanctions hit review initiated, OFSI notification deadline (detected_at + 14 days), case reference. WORM entry. Regulatory SLA tracking begins.

data.audit_entry: { event_type: MLROReviewInitiated, case_ref, customer_id, assessment_id, ofsi_notification_deadline, reviewed_by: PER-052, initiated_at }

steps.description: MLRO reviews sanctions match detail, confirms the customer is a designated person under UK Russia Sanctions Regulations 2019. Decision: OFSI notification required within 14 days (GOV-005-R02). No voluntary disclosure to customer.

data.mlro_decision: Confirmed designated person. OFSI notification required within 14 days of detected_at.

steps.action: WORM audit log — OFSI notification submitted
steps.description: MLRO submits OFSI notification (within 14-day SLA). WORM audit log records: OFSI notification reference, submission timestamp, MLRO staff ID. This is the regulatory compliance evidence for GOV-005-R02.

data.audit_entry: { event_type: OFSINotificationSubmitted, case_ref, customer_id, ofsi_notification_ref, submitted_by: PER-052, submitted_at, within_sla: true }

steps.note: SLA: OFSI notification within 14 days of confirmed designated person identification. Failure to notify is a criminal offence under UK financial sanctions legislation.

steps.action: WORM audit log — funds freeze confirmed (if applicable)
steps.description: If any funds were received into a provisional account (edge case: should not occur given blocking at PH-003), SVC-001 records the freeze. In this journey, no account was provisioned so no funds were accepted. WORM entry confirms no assets received.

data.audit_entry: { event_type: FundsFreezeConfirmed, customer_id, application_id, account_created: false, funds_received: 0.00, freeze_confirmed_at }

notes: EX-002 regulatory SLA: OFSI notification must occur within 14 days of confirmed designated person identification (GOV-005-R02). Non-compliance is a criminal offence.
Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) is absolute: customer must not be informed of sanctions match at any point.
All SanctionsHitDetected audit log entries are WORM (Write-Once Read-Many) — immutable and tamper-evident.
WORM audit log (SVC-111) retention: minimum 5 years (MLR 2017 Regulation 40). OFSI cases retained for 5 years after case closure.

The SanctionsHitDetected event payload published to SVC-102 does not contain match_detail — only what is needed for downstream blocking actions. Full match detail stays within SVC-014 and SVC-111 access-controlled stores.
Precedent: Starling Bank FCA fine (£29m, October 2024) for incomplete screening coverage. 100% applicant coverage with no sampling or deferral is mandatory.
MLRO case management is outside the scope of this API design — alerts are delivered via SVC-014 internal compliance notification workflow.
